_comment: Edit this file, then run:  python blogger/homepage/build_theme.py
Every value is substituted into src/homepage.xml at build time, so the
generated theme contains plain literals and stays readable in Blogger's
Any image URL left empty renders a styled CSS placeholder instead of a
broken image, so the page is presentable before photography is hosted.

site.name: Youdle
site.definition: Youdle brings together grocery news, recalls, price changes, shopper finds, and tools to help people shop smarter.
site.footer_about: Youdle connects you with real grocery information and a community of shoppers to help you save time, money, and stress.

urls._comment: Verified live 2026-08-31. See README.md 'Link map' for provenance.

newsletter._comment: Existing Mailchimp integration, carried over verbatim from the theme's youdleNewsletterSignup includable so subscribers land on the same list.

_comment: Blogger cannot host theme assets, so these must be absolute URLs.
Starter placeholders extracted from the approved comp live in
blogger/homepage/assets/img/ - upload them (or real photography) and
paste the URLs here. Leave a value empty to render a CSS placeholder.
The local preview server substitutes its own local paths, so you can
see the intended design before anything is hosted.

_comment: Blogger emits <title>, meta description and Open Graph tags from
Settings, so we do NOT duplicate them here. Recommended values to set
in Blogger Settings are documented in README.md. Twitter Card tags are
not emitted by Blogger, so we add those.
